title: LOXDockAudit: A Reproducible Framework for Control-Aware Productive Geometry Analysis in LOX-Collagen Docking Screens
description: LOXDockAudit is a negative-control-aware computational triage tool for LOX-Collagen engineering. It analyzes docking models to determine whether LOX constructs are positioned near collagen Lys/Hyl substrate residues in potentially productive catalytic geometry, while detecting nonspecific binding, CBD trapping, invalid controls, and failure to outperform simpler baselines. Includes structural QC (His triad, Lys-Tyr, disulfide geometry, active-site accessibility), control-aware screen comparison, input auditing with SHA256 verification, and a reproducible real HDOCK Round 5 dataset (LOX169-417 vs collagen-I 6VZX).
